main_text.p: מלחה f. Salsugo; ארץ מלחה Terra salsuginis, id est, sal-suginosa, Jer.17.6. ארץ פרי למלחה Terram fructus in sal-suginem, Psal.107.34. id est, fructuosam in salsuginosam.
מלחים m.p. Evanida, Vestimenta detrita, Jer.38.11.

מַלָּחִים m.p. Nautae, Jonae 1.5. marini proprie, à Salo vel Salsa aqua maris sic dicti, vel quod reliquam aquam Cômiscent, ut R.Salomon scribit, juxta significationem Participii in Pyh. Aff. מלחיהם Et nautae earum, Ezech.27.9.

מלט Niph. נמלט Ereptus, Liberatus fuit, Eripuit, Eruit; Liberavit, Recepit se, Evasit: Praet. ולא נמלט איש Et non evasit quisquam, Jud.3.29. Pih. מלט נפשו Animam suam eripuit, Ezech.33.5. Fut. אמלט עני Eripiam pauperem, Job.29.12. Item, Peperit, q.d. Evadere fecit foetum: Unde, ותמלט Et evadere faciet, Jes.34.15. id est, Pariet, Ponet, sil. ova sua. Hiph. Praet. והמליטה זכר Et peperit marem, Jesa.66.7. Infin. פסוח והמליט Transfeundo & liberando, Jes.31.5. cum Chirek sub ה loco Pathach, juxta Kimchium: Simile vide in דרך. Hithp. ואתמלטו Et ereptus sum, Job.19.20. יתמלטו Proripiunt sese, Job.4.1.10.

מלך Regnavit, Rex fuit: Frequenter cum על construitur: Praet. ויםלך מלך Et regnabit rex, Jer.23.v.5. Imp. מלך־עלינו Regna super nos, Jud.9.14. Niph. נמלך Consilium iniit, ex usu Chaldaico. Fut. ויפלך Et consilium iniit, Nehem.5.7. Hiph. המליך Regnare fecit, Regem praefecit, Regem constituit: Praeterit: המליך את־שלומה Regem constituit Salomonem, 1.Reg.1. v.43. והמלכת להם מלך Et praeficies eis regem, 1.Sam.8.22. Hoph. Praeter. אשר המלך Qui rex factus fuit, Dan.9.1.
מלך m. Rex: Aff. ואת־מלכך Et regem tuum, Deut.28.36: Plur

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some abbreviations are hard to read at this scan resolution; the consonants are copied as seen. "ויםלך" in the entry for מלך may be ויִמְלֹךְ with a misprinted letter [?]. "Cômiscent" and "Pyh." are doubtful readings. Long s was set as plain s throughout. The entry ends with "Plur" and continues on the next page.
